title: Tunisian Potholder
description: A dense square project that introduces the rhythm of Tunisian crochet.
expectationText: A compact square that helps you learn forward and return passes while keeping edge loops visible and even from row to row.

steps.title: Chain the width
steps.instruction: Create a foundation chain that matches the width you want for the potholder.

steps.title: Forward pass
steps.instruction: Pull up one loop in each chain and leave them on the hook.

steps.title: Return pass
steps.instruction: Yarn over and work loops off according to the Tunisian return pass sequence.

steps.title: Build the fabric
steps.instruction: Repeat forward and return passes until the piece becomes square.

steps.title: Bind off
steps.instruction: Use a simple bind off across the top edge, then fasten off and weave in ends.
